lines.text: Your team spends hours on search analysis.
What if it took just one click?
Meet SearchVerse.
Smart, AI-powered search tools, built for SEO teams.
Where is your traffic really coming from?
Performance Explorer shows your clicks, impressions and rankings,
split by every product line, in one view.
Who is on track, and who needs help?
Search Workspace lets you set deadlines for every task,
and see each person's performance score at a glance.
Is your website too slow?
PageSpeed Lab tests hundreds of pages at once,
and shows exactly which pages need fixing.
What are your competitors writing that you're not?
Topic Planner reads their websites and yours,
and finds every topic you're missing.
Then it scores each topic for your brand,
and writes a full content brief, in one click.
Are your videos showing up in search?
Video Visibility tracks where you rank on YouTube,
compared with other channels.
Built for teams.
Shared projects, five roles, and access only with approval.
SearchVerse is now live for testing.
We're testing a few more modules before we roll them out.
Request beta access, and tell us what you think!
